h1: Autonomous AI Agents Built for Grenada Workflows

uses.d: Automate guest communication across Grand Anse and Lance aux Epines, syncing reservation calendars and guest records in Google Sheets.

Integrate Telegram, Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs, or your preferred services from over 1,000 supported apps.
Assign routine research, coding, or communication tasks that run 24/7 even when your devices are shut down.

chapters.d: Your bot scans incoming maritime logistics and guest messages, delivering an organized briefing to your Telegram group before your day begins.
While you conduct meetings in St. George's, your browser agent reviews international trade directories and compiles pricing data into a shared sheet.
Your coding agent develops and verifies custom automation scripts in its isolated virtual environment, preparing production-ready integrations.
With your laptop turned off, your agents continue answering international traveler inquiries and executing scheduled nightly database cleanups.

faq.q: How does Ceyo pricing and the free trial work in Grenada?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three monthly plans billed in USD: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day. A card is linked upon registration and is only charged when the trial ends unless cancelled beforehand.

faq.q: Can I run my agents through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo allows you to control individual bots directly via Telegram. You can also assemble multiple specialist agents into Telegram group chats where they cooperate as an autonomous team.

faq.q: What makes the autonomous cloud computer unique?
faq.a: Each bot runs on its own isolated virtual cloud machine that operates 24/7 independently of your local hardware or internet connection. It features an autonomous browser to complete web tasks and an integrated execution environment for coding.

faq.q: Which languages and business tools are supported?
faq.a: Ceyo agents converse fluently in English, French, Spanish, and dozens of global languages. They integrate natively with over 1,000 popular business applications including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, and various CRMs.

faq.q: How is my operational data stored and secured?
faq.a: Every agent operates within a secure, sandboxed cloud environment. Your documents, shared memory, and routines remain private to your account, giving you full control over your workflows and data assets.
